children: First Breach, Inc. reported results for the second quarter of 2026 with essentially flat revenue year-over-year but a wider net loss versus the prior-year quarter. Revenue held at $95.35K, while the company recorded a net loss of $13.88M and diluted loss per share of $(0.26).
Revenue: $95.35K for Q2 2026, essentially flat versus $95.22K in the year-ago quarter (0.1% YoY).
Net income: Net loss $13.88M for Q2 2026 versus net loss $2.24M in the year-ago quarter (wider loss YoY).
Diluted EPS: $(0.26) for Q2 2026 versus $(0.06) in the year-ago quarter (more negative YoY).
Revenue growth for the first six months rose 226% year-over-year, driven by a strategic shift in core product offerings.
Management is expanding distributor and e-commerce channels to diversify sales and build a broader customer pipeline.
Investments in product quality include new inspection equipment and the launch of match-grade ammunition components with custom options.
UAS development began via a joint venture, First Forge and MSA, to build two Class 1 FPV drone prototypes.
Operational scaling efforts focus on sales hiring and pipeline development while evaluating strategic initiatives to support growth.
